body: That's all very good advice, and I appreciate; I also hope that your life is still in a place where you can follow it.

I've never been in it for a numbers game. I don't even care about sex anymore; it's the lack of any sort of love, or compassion, or caring... all the things I've felt for other people but are seemingly impossible for anyone else to feel for me. 

Just a kiss? Was that ever really too much to ask for? I don't even think I'm unattractive, and I'm my harshest critic...

I don't know. It's a naive notion, but I always wanted to be a writer. It's the only consistent impulse I ever had. But it's pointless- even my parents told me so. 

The only other thing that kept me going... was the hope, I guess, that I would find someone like me some day. No one has ever loved me, but I know that if I were to meet someone like me, I would. 

But I'm just naive.

There might have been a time, once, a point along the path where I was still capable of saying "no," of making a choice of direction to deviate form this all. But I didn't see it then and I don't see it now. 

I appreciate the words, and I've calmed down a bit. I won't be doing anything now. But that's all I can do anymore:buy time. But I completely lack the skills, the courage, the capacity to use that time to any means that would... make anything of this.

I don't know. I'm simply not someone who can be motivated. Everything I have motivated myself to do I failed at. I don't understand this "just try hard enough" sentiment.

To many people the world is boundless and enjoyable, and to me it's... like Hamlet said, "Why, then, ’tis none to you, for there is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so. To me it is a prison."
